exposure: GDM diagnosis by National Diabetes Data Group (NDDG) criteria
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent a 100-g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) for diagnosing GDM between January 2009 and December 2012 at Siriraj Hospital, Bangkok
finding: Using the CC criteria for GDM diagnosis led to a higher incidence of GDM and a higher risk of neonatal hypoglycemia and hyperbilirubinemia compared to the NDDG criteria, but managing women with GDM diagnosed by CC criteria according to a specific program improved neonatal outcomes.
